params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; Write-Output ('HEAD=' + (git rev-parse HEAD)); Write-Output ('NODE=' + (node --version)); Write-Output '===NPM COMMANDS==='; Get-Command npm -All | Select-Object CommandType,Name,Source,Definition | Format-List; Set-Location 'tools\agent-control'; $files=@('server.mjs','agentctl.mjs','lib/control-core.mjs','lib/autopilot-core.mjs','lib/prompt-templates.mjs'); foreach($f in $files){ Write-Output ('===CHECK ' + $f + '==='); & node --check $f 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_ }; Write-Output ('EXIT=' + $LASTEXITCODE) }; Write-Output '===NPM.CMD CHECK==='; & npm.cmd run check 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_ }; Write-Output ('NPM_CHECK_EXIT=' + $LASTEXITCODE); Write-Output '===NPM.CMD TEST==='; & npm.cmd test 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_ }; Write-Output ('NPM_TEST_EXIT=' + $LASTEXITCODE); exit 0

purpose: Diagnose the reconciled Agent Control npm check exit without losing individual Node syntax-check and test evidence.
